description: xai-grok-brain relation-graph health metric: hub_excess = (hub_share - k/n)/(1 - k/n) with hub_k clamped to (nodes/2).max(1), thresholded at 0.25, and a MIN_NODES_FOR_HUB_VERDICT=5 refusal floor.

boundaryCases.expected: hub_excess exactly 0.0, Healthy at every size
bit-identical excess 0.3333; both refuse a hub verdict rather than flag one wrongly
still HubDominated; widening the knob cannot disable detection

adversarialHistory: The red-team lane falsified this metric twice: gen-2 (every graph with <6 nodes and >=1 edge forced HubDominated by the unnormalized share) and gen-4 (the 0.35 cutoff sat inside the star ramp so 3- and 4-node stars read Healthy). Both closed; both directions now swept.
